stepInstruction: Verify that the Yemeksepeti splash screen has loaded.

condition.intent: Confirm the app has started and the splash screen is visible
condition.stepInstruction: Wait until the red splash screen with the 'y' logo appears.

stepInstruction: Verify that the login or onboarding screen has loaded.

condition.intent: Confirm the onboarding/login screen is visible
condition.stepInstruction: Wait until the 'Sign up or log in' options or the 'Skip' button appear.

intent: Close the Flash Deals popup to reveal the restaurant list
stepInstruction: Click the 'X' on the Flash Deals banner.
Click on the delivery address at the top of the home screen to change or add an address.

intent: Select the existing address to continue to the home screen
stepInstruction: Click on the 'Orta Sabanci Universitesi A4' address option.

intent: Search for Little Caesars Pizza and view the results
stepInstruction: Type 'little ceasers pizza' into the search bar and press enter.
Click on the Little Caesars Pizza restaurant card in the search results.
Click on the 'Mixed (Medium) Pizza' item in the menu.

intent: Select Normal Dough for the Mixed (Medium) pizza
stepInstruction: On the Mixed (Medium) pizza screen, select 'Normal Dough'.

intent: Select the sauce option to complete the requirements
stepInstruction: Select 'Less Pizza Sauce' from the customization menu.

intent: Remove Mushrooms and Black Olives from the Mixed (Medium) pizza
stepInstruction: On the Mixed (Medium) pizza customization screen, select 'I Don't Want Mushrooms' and 'I Don't Want Black Olives'.

intent: Add the Mixed (Medium) pizza to the cart and verify the indicator
stepInstruction: Click 'Add to cart' and confirm the cart bar shows '1' Mixed (Medium) pizza.

intent: Open the cart to review the 'Mixed (Medium) Pizza' before checking out
stepInstruction: Click the 'View your cart' red bar at the bottom to see your selection.

intent: Proceed to checkout with the Mixed (Medium) pizza
stepInstruction: Click 'Confirm basket' to proceed to the payment screen for your Mixed (Medium) pizza.

intent: The screenshot shows the 'Mediterranean (Central)' pizza and its customizations in the order summary, but there is no visible information about the 'Mixed (Medium)' pizza that was requested.
instruction: Visually inspect the checkout screen and confirm that the 'Mixed (Medium)' pizza from 'Little Caesars' is selected.
stepInstruction: Visually verify the 'Mixed (Medium)' pizza selection and the Little Caesars restaurant from the checkout summary.
